_meta.description: Grammar-Guided Generation rules for the Autonomous IDE LLM sidecar. Constrains token sampling to emit only valid unified diff patches or structured JSON code-patch arrays. Prevents conversational chatter, introductory remarks, and variable name hallucinations at the token generation level.

unified_diff.description: Constrains the model to emit only valid unified diff patch blocks.
unified_diff.grammar:
root        ::= patch+
patch       ::= old-header new-header hunk+
old-header  ::= "--- " path "\n"
new-header  ::= "+++ " path "\n"
path        ::= [a-zA-Z] prefix? segments
prefix      ::= "/ " | ""
segments    ::= segment ("/" segment)*
segment     ::= [a-zA-Z0-9._-]+
hunk        ::= hunk-header hunk-line+
hunk-header ::= "@@ -" range " +" range " @@" context? "\n"
range       ::= [0-9]+ ("," [0-9]+)?
context     ::= " " [^\n]*
hunk-line   ::= add-line | del-line | ctx-line
add-line    ::= "+" [^\n]* "\n"
del-line    ::= "-" [^\n]* "\n"
ctx-line    ::= " " [^\n]* "\n"

json_patch_array.description: Constrains the model to emit a JSON array of structured code patch objects aligned with the graph_manager node schema.

file_path.description: Relative path to the target file from project root.

node_type.description: Graph node type from graph_manager.js NODE_TYPES. Constrains the model to only reference valid entity types.

edge_type.description: Graph edge type from graph_manager.js EDGE_TYPES. Used when the patch modifies inter-node relationships.

change_kind.description: Change classification from graph_manager.js CHANGE_KINDS. Determines blast-radius propagation.

start_line.description: 1-indexed start line of the region to replace.

end_line.description: 1-indexed end line of the region to replace (inclusive).

original.description: Exact text of the original region. Used for conflict detection.

replacement.description: The replacement code text. Empty string to delete a region.

sampling_parameters.description: Sampling parameters tuned for deterministic code generation. Low temperature + stop sequences that hard-cut conversational preambles.

banned_token_patterns.description: Regex patterns matched against decoded token sequences. Any match causes the token to be rejected and resampled. Prevents conversational filler at the structural level.

structural_constraints.description: Hard rules enforced at the output validation layer. If the complete output fails any of these checks, it is rejected before reaching the diff applier.

rules.description: Output must not contain markdown code fences (triple backticks). The model emits raw diffs, not fenced blocks.
In unified_diff mode, the output must begin with a valid diff header line.
In json_patch_array mode, the output must be a valid JSON array.
Any node_type field must match one of the graph_manager.js NODE_TYPES enum values.
Any edge_type field must match one of the graph_manager.js EDGE_TYPES enum values.
Any change_kind field must match one of the graph_manager.js CHANGE_KINDS enum values.
Each patch object must have at least one hunk or replacement entry.
File paths must not contain directory traversal sequences (..) to prevent sandbox escape.

identifier_vocabulary.description: Constrained vocabulary aligned with graph_manager.js schema types. When the model generates identifiers in structured JSON mode, token sampling is biased toward these known-valid values to prevent hallucinated node/edge type strings.

llama_cpp_integration.description: Configuration keys passed directly to the llama.cpp server via its API or CLI flags. The grammar field uses GBNF (Generalized Backus-Naur Form) natively supported by llama.cpp.

api_fields.grammar: Loaded from output_modes[output_mode].grammar when grammar_type is 'gbnf'.
api_fields.json_schema: Loaded from output_modes[output_mode].schema when grammar_type is 'json_schema'.

cli_flags.--grammar-file: Path to a .gbnf file extracted from this config.
